✦ a little note

These last two days
were everything.

✦

I don't know how to explain it — but being with you these past two days felt like the kind of time you wish you could bottle up and keep forever. Every little moment, every laugh, every quiet second — I didn't want any of it to end.

And then it did. And the second we said goodbye, something in me went quiet. Like the whole world turned down its volume the moment you left.

I started missing you before I even got home.

I keep replaying it all. The way you smiled. The way you made everything feel so easy and so warm. I'd do those two days a hundred times over without thinking twice.

Thank you for them. Thank you for you.

all my hugs & kisses

Every single one of them —
saved just for you, my sunshine. 🌙
